The annex instead obtains 𝔉(Φ(𝔉))=𝔉 from the book-route HSP characterization (A 345-347) and F(B,n) from modern equational completeness (A 303-318); the source's ordinal-arity/transfinite-rank and possibly-empty/partial-domain hypotheses are excluded rather than proved (P 225-232, A 398-400).

Give the explicit worked reconstruction and source-to-host bridge for the remaining 1935 items: the source's subalgebra, direct-product, meromorphic- and central-product conventions, Definitions 4-5, Theorems 6 (with corollaries), 8 and 9, and the ordinal-index species scope have no bridge; the present bridge covers only the finitary specialization and does not preserve the original Theorem 9/10 proof route (it substitutes the modern equality/deduction bridge, P 303-310, A 296-320).

Equation preservation under H/S/P, the converse construction and the empty-class/trivial-variety boundary are present, but the reconciliation is with the Burris-Sankappanavar book's nonempty-product convention only (P 34-42, 199-214; A 203-218, 234-239). Reconcile the 1935 source's own product convention (direct products of a well-ordered family A1,...,An, §7 printed 437-438; families generated from a set basis, Definition 4 printed 440) with the host's empty product, including the empty basis; the 1935-route theorem assumes a nonempty basis (P 245; A 267-269, 345).

Supply the proofs of Theorem 7 (1)-(2) in the source's terms and of Theorem 9 by its native rules (algebra structure of F(B,m) by rule (1), satisfaction of B by rule (2), homomorphic-image property, laws of F(B,m) on m symbols in Φ(B)); the completeness/equational-class argument is proved only by the modern quotient T(V)/θ_Γ (EQA 30-121) and transported through the modern bridge (A 296-320).

Give a worked reconstruction of the native Theorem 9 route and a statement bridge from Φ(B), F(B,m) and rules (1)-(2) of Theorem 7 to θ_Γ and T(V)/θ_Γ, showing where reflexivity/symmetry/transitivity are supplemented; the present bridge (P 281-291, 325-331) only records that the modern deduction calculus is used instead.

The modern reconstruction is complete (global consequence, fully invariant θ_Γ, premises under every valuation EQA 85-104, separation EQA 106-112, finiteness EQA 114-120).
